༄༅/ /bde mchog dril bu lugs kyi mngon rtogs bzhugs pa legs par bkod/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bde mchog dril bu lugs kyi mngon rtogs bzhugs pa legs par bkod/ /

na mo mañdzu shrī ye/ dpal ldan khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa' yi/ /sprul pa'i 'khor lo thams cad lhan skyes bder/ /sdom mdzad dpal ldan bla ma bde mchog la/ /btud nas dril bu zhabs kyi sgrub thab 'bri/ /de la bod phal cher bde mchog la rgya gar na lo nag dril gsum/ bod na mar 'gos mal gsum sogs kyi bshad pa so so'i khyad par mi 'dra ba phran tshegs mang po 'byed cing*/ lugs kyi gtso bo dbang bzhi pa'i lam la gtso bo bsten pa/ sems 'grel gyi lugs kyi dbang gsum pa'i lam la gtso bor bsten pa mar brgyud dngos kyi dbang gnyis pa'i lam la gtso bor bsten pa/ pha brgyud sgo bstun gyi bde mchog ste/ gsum du rig pas legs par grub pa rnams ma phyed par bsres nas lung 'gal mang du 'byung ba rnams la 'gal spong gi ched du ngal dub du ma byas zhing*/ lugs gsum bsres pas lam gyi gnad 'chugs pa mang du byung bar snang ngo*/ khau bo ni lugs gsum so sor phye ste/ lugs dang po sems 'grel gsum la bsten pa'i sgrub dkyil dang*/ gsum pa nag po spyod pa'i sgrub dkyil sogs byas zin pas/ 'dir lugs gnyis pa lo dril gnyis cha lag dang bcas pa bshad par bya ba las/ re zhig grub chen dril bu zhabs kyi rim gnyis rmad du byung pa dbang po rnon po'am rnal 'byor pa 'thon po'i 'jug tshul gdod mas rang chas su grub pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi nyams len gyi nang nas bskyed rim kyi rnal 'byor brjod par bya'o/ /de'ang rgya gzhung 'di ha cang 'dus pas bskyed rim 'gros bzhi'i nang nas gang du bsdud/ sbyangs gzhi sbyong byed kyi gtso bor sku gsum lam 'khyer rnams shin tu mi gsal bas/ bod snga ma rnams kyis dogs gcod tsam yang ma mdzad la/ phyi ma 'ga' res sbyar ba'ang lo hi pa dang 'gros gcig tu nges par sbyor rgyu ma 'byor bas/ chos kyi rjes 'brang yid mgu bar ni ma gyur to/

/dkyil 'khor 'di lta bu'i lus dkyil gyi sgrub gzhi dang sgrub tshul la dogs gcod rgya cher byas nas dpyad pas dag par rloms pa dag la'ang*/ da dung brgal zhing brtag pa'i gnad mang du yod do/ /des na 'di la gnyis te/ rnam bzhag lung gnyis kyis nges par bya ba dang*| nyams len tshigs bcad kyis dbyangs su bsnyad pa'o/ /dang po la sgrub gzhi la dogs pa gcad pa dang*/ sgrub tshul la dogs par gcad pa'o/ /dang po ni ji skad du/ 'gro ba 'di dag rang bzhin gyis/ /grub pa'i dkyil 'khor gnyis med pa'o/ /bcos ma gnyis kyi ngo bo gang*/ /de ni gdul bya'i dbang las 'dod| |mkhas pa'i sgrub bya de min te/ /de nyid don mthong grub phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i bcos ma ni/ /ri mor bris pa'i las dang ni/ /thig gdab tshon dgye'i rim pa bstan/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rdul tshon dang ras bris sogs yin pas de gnyis dang*/ me tog tshom bu sogs gru bzhir byas nas lus dkyil du 'dod pa ni shin tu mi rigs la/ gzhi lus kyi gnas so sor sa bon sogs las bskyed pa'i lha la lus dkyil du 'dod pa'ang mi mthad de/ 'jam rdor sogs lus dkyil ma gsungs pa rnams la'ang bskyed tshul de yod pa'i phyir ro| |lus yongs su gyur nas bskyed pa tsam gyis der 'dod pa'ang mi rigs te| rgyud sde 'og ma la'ang lus dkyil yod par thal ba'i phyir ro/ /des na lus sgrub gzhir song tshul khyad par ba gcig shes dgos la/ de yang mkhas pa dag pha ma'i 'byung bzhi las gsar du grub pa'i lus rags pa rnam smin skyes 'di kho na sgrub gzhir 'dod pa ni ras bris sogs dang legs par mtshungs so/ /pha mas lag bzo ma byas pas sgrub gzhir mthad do zhes na/ nus ldan gyis sprul pa'i rdul tshon sogs kyang lus dkyil gyi sgrub gzhir 'gyur ro/ /des na rang bzhin gyis te gdod ma nas thog ma'i mtha' med du grub pa'i gnyug ma'i lus ni sgrub gzhi'i gtso bo yin la/

gnyis med ces pa'i tshig gis blo lhan skyes 'khrul pa la 'char ba'i lus rags pa'ang zur du ma phyed bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa la| gtso bo dang phal pa la dogs pa gcad pa'o/ /dang po ni gang zag rten gyi lus dkyil/ lus sgyur btong tsam ma gtogs/ phyi dkyil gyi gnas dang mdog dbyibs ji bzhin du 'dod pa ni mi 'thad de/ brten pa'i gnas dang grangs sogs kyang de ltar thal ba'i phyir ro/ /'di ni bre nang bre bcug ma'ang khegs la| khyad par lugs 'di la ni phyi dkyil 'ong don med cing*/ kyai rdo rje yang 'di bzhin no/ /des na rje btsun gong ma dag lus gzhal g.yas khang la sogs pa'i rang bzhin dang dbyibs ldan du rang chas su yod pa/ ngo ma 'phrod pa'i de nyid rgyud dang grub chen gyi man ngag gi ngo sprad nas shin tu gsal bar sgoms pa nyid lus dkyil sgrub tshul du bzhed pa ni shin tu legs pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ sku gsum lam khyer med par byas na bskyed rim yongs rdzogs su mi 'gyur la/ de ltar na bskyed rim kyi mchog tu 'dod pa dang 'gal bas sku gsum lam khyer yang ngo 'phrod cing rnam pa gsal ba dgos so/ /de yang bskyed rim lam 'gros bzhi las/ dus 'khor dang gsang 'dus lugs gnyis dang mthun don med pas/ lo hi pa dang mthun pa las 'os med la/ de ltar na de'i khyad chos kyi gtso bo mngon byang lnga rten dang brten pa gcig char tu bskyed pa yin pas/ de 'di la'ang mkhas pa dag gis sbyar ba ni legs mod kyi/ rten gzhi lus dang phral nas phyi ru bskyed pa dang*/ brten pa phyi'i he ru ka rkyang pa las mi bskyed par/ lus dkyil go cha dang bcas pa la phyis bskyed chog zur pa mdzad pa ni 'di dang lo hi pa gnyis ka la 'thad pa ma yin no/ /rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor cig car dus gcig tu rdzogs par grub pa ni/ zhes pa'i ngag 'don nan gyis byas pa dang khas blangs kyang 'gal ba'i phyir ro/

/gnyis pa ni/ nang mchod phyogs mdog sogs la lo dril ma rgyud dngos yin la de la yum gtso che zhing yum gyi rigs bdag rnam snang yin pas/ de'i sa bon dang sku mdog dbus dang rdo rje'i rigs shar du legs par grub cing*/ shar dkar por bshad pa'i rgyud dang rgya gzhung thams cad pha brgyud sgo bstun gyi lung yin pas 'dir mi 'byor ro/ /ra ba gru bzhi pa dang phur gdab sogs lo hi par gsungs pa rnams spro na'ang rung mod kyi/ 'chi ba chos sku'i 'jug tu byas na lo hi pa dang ma mthun zhing bsrungs 'khor thun mong ba nyis brtsegs tu 'gyur ba'i skyon 'byung ngo*/ /des na gnas dang yo byad gang 'byor bshams pa'i sar stan bde ba la 'dug ste thog mar rang nyid thun mtshams kyi lhar gsal btab nas nang mchod dang mchod pa byin gyis brlabs/ sngon 'gro'i gtor ma btang*/ skyabs 'gro yig brgya'i bar ni ring ba'i sngon 'gro dang*/ de nas sgo gsum sbyangs te tshogs gnyis bsags pa ni nye ba'i sngon 'gro'o/ /de nas ye shes kyi tshogs kyi mthar snang ba bsdus pa ni 'chi ba chos sku'i rnal 'byor ro/ /de nas nā da nam mkhar bzhag ste rang gzhi lus kyi cha shas rags pa rnams dkyil 'khor gyi rten 'byung bzhi ri rab sna tshogs pad+ma rnams su skyed pa'i pad+ma'i lte bar dbyangs gsal las zla ba dkar dmar bsam pa'i dbus su nā da zhugs nas hūm̐ du gyur pa ni bar do longs sku'i rnal 'byor ro/ /de man chad ni skye ba sprul sku'i rnal 'byor te mngon byang lhag ma gsum gyi mthar skad cig ma'i sngags brjod pas sna tshogs pad+ma'i steng du rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang bsrungs 'khor dur khrod sogs rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor go cha dang bcas pa gcig char grub nas rim gyi gsal gtab ste yan lag bzhi rdzogs mchod do/ bzlas pa'i mthar nyer bsdu smon lam dang bcas pa ni bdag bskyed yin la thun mtshams su mdun bskyed bsgrub mchod byed pa ni/

phyi dkyil yod pa'i rnam gzhag yin pas 'di la mi rung bas na/ mdun bskyed spro zhing dgos na/ nyer bsdu'i gong du rang gi snying kha'i gtso bo las gtso bo gnyis pa lhan skyes yab yum du bye nas dkyil 'khor gyi mdun du gnas pas mchod pa rgyas pa dang bdag 'jug dang*/ der slob ma 'jug pa sogs byas pa'i mthar nyer bsdu bya ba yin no/ /de nas thun mtshams su ni gtor ma dang kha zas sogs kyi spyod lam rnams bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ ri bo tshang tshing sman ljongs dang*/ /gdod nas grub pa'i dur khrod sogs/ /mtshan ldan gnas dang phyag rgya dang*/ /nyer mkho'i yo byad kun ldan par/ /rang nyid dpal ldan he ru ka /sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa| |phyag rgya drug ldan g.yas rkyang btabs/ /rdo dril 'dzin pas phag mo dmar| |gcer mo phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ /gri thod 'dzin la 'khyud par gyur// oṃ khan+ṭa ro he hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ shun+ya tā dzñān badz+ra swa bha wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ raṃ las byung ba'i/ /rlung me'i dkyil 'khor ljang dang dmar po ni/ /gzhu dbyibs gru gsum rgyal mtshan raṃ gyis mtshan/ /'bru gsum las skyes mgo rlon sgyed bu'i steng*/ /oṃ yig las byung mtshan ldan thod pa cher/ /dbus nas shar sogs g.yon bskor phyogs bzhir oṃ/ /hūm̐ khaṃ aṃ traṃ dkar sngo ljang dmar ser// yongs gyur dri chen dri chu klad pa dang/ /dkar dmar rang rang sa bon gyis mtshan gyur| |dbus dang me sogs mtshams bzhi g.yas bskor gyis/ /bāṃ māṃ lāṃ pāṃ tāṃ rnams dmar sngo ser/ /dmar ljang las skyes mi khyi ba lang dang*/ /glang chen rta sha rang rang yi ges mtshan/ /rang snying sprin sgras rlung g.yos me sbar te/ /rdzas sngags bcu phrag gnyis khos dmar ser gyur/ kha trāṃ ga dkar bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin can/ /zhu nas thims pas dngul chu ltar bsil gyur/ /de steng dbyangs gsal kha dog sna tshogs rnams/

/gcig gyur 'bru gsum dkar dmar sngo ba las| |'od 'phros snod bcud spyi dgos bdud rtsir bkug /'gro kun 'khor lo gsum gyi lhar byas te/ /dpa' bo yab yum bkug rnams snyoms par zhugs| |'bru gsum la thims gsum yang rim gyis zhu/ /thod par lhung bas zag med bdud rtsir gyur/ /yang sngags gnyis brjod/ stong pa'i ngang las āḥlas thod chen du/ /hūm̐ las chu gsum nyer spyod lnga la sogs/ /spyir dgos mchod sprin nam mkha' kun khyab cing*/ /zag med bde stong rnam pa kun ldan no// oṃ ār+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du pā t+yaṃ = āñtsa mā ṇaṃ= puṣ+pe= dhu pe= dī pe= gan+dhe= nai we d+ye= shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ sngon 'gro'i mchod pa'ang de bzhin dang gtor ma nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi thugs ka'i 'od kyis dur khrod nas/ /phyogs zhing skyong dang klu chen sogs ba ste/ /phyogs mtshams brgyad du 'khod rnams 'od gsal bcug /bde mchog yab yum skur bzhengs ljags la hūm̐/ /dkar po las byung rdo rje sbu gus gsol/ /oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba yak+ṣa rwak+ṣa sa/ bhū ta pre ta pi sha tsa un+man da a pasma ra ḍā ka ḍā ki n+yā da yo/ i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇa tu/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ ma ma sarba sing+ngh-i m+me pra yats+tshan+tu/ ya thai boṃ/ ya thai ṣ+tam̐/ bhū dza thā/ dzi ga thā/ pī ba thā/ ma ti kra ma thā/ ma ma sarba kat+ya/ sata su khaṃ bi shung+ngha sa ha yi ka bha wan+tu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ gnyis sam gsum gyis dbul ār+ghaṃ sogs dang oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lha klu gnod sbyin srin po dang*/ /'byung po yi dwags sha za dang*/ /smyo byed brjed byed mkha' 'gro dang*/ /ma mo'i tshogs rnams ma lus te/ /ma lus pa ni thams cad dag |'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bstan pa bsrungs dang 'gro ba'i don mdzad phyir/ /thugs dam bcas shing zhal gyi mches pa rnams// dpal chen bka' sdod yid ltar mgyogs pa yi/ /'jigs pa'i gzugs can gtum drag mi bzad pa/

/gdug pa 'dul byed nag po'i phyogs rnams 'joms| |rnal 'byor las la 'bras bu ster mdzad cing*/ /mthu stobs byin brlabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i/ /gnod sbyin tshogs sogs brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sde brgyad btsun mo sras dang g.yog bcas pa'i/ /dngos grub kun gyi bka' drin bdag la stsaul/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*/ /dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang*/ /longs spyod rgya chen kun 'grub cing*/ /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsaul/ /bsrungs mas rtag tu btong grogs mdzod/ /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*/ /gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*/ /'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel ba/ /bde legs thams cad 'byung ba dang*/ /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra muḥ 'jig rten pa rnams rang gnas su gshegs par gyur/ sgrub grogs yod na gsol ba 'debs su bzhugs/ skyabs 'gro spro na thun mong ba'ang bya/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /theg pa gsum po thams cad dang*/ /rnal 'byor gsang sngags mkha' 'gro ma/ /dpal bo dpa' mo dbang lha mo/ /byang chub sems dpa' bdag nyid che/ khyad par du yang slob dpon la/ /rtag tu skyabs su mchi bar bgyi/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag ni he ru kar gyur nas/ /sems can thams cad he ru ka'i/ /go 'phangs mchog la dgod par bgyi/ lan gsum/ rang gi spyi bor pad zlar rdo rje sems| |dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdor dril 'dzin/ /snyem ma dkar mo gri thod 'dzin par 'khyud/ /phyag rgya drug dang lngas brgyan bde chen 'bar/ /ye shes skur gyur thugs ka'i zla bar ni/ /hūm̐ gi mtha' mar yi ge brgya pas bskor// bdud rtsi babs pas sgo gsum dri ma dag

/oṃ badz+ra he ru ka sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya| badz+ra he ru ka te no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ ḍī ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ sarba sing+nghi m+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsit+taṃ shṝ yaḥ/ ku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ/ bha ga wān/ badz+ra he ru ka ma me muñtsa/ badz+ra he ru ko bha wa ma hā sa ma ya sa twa āḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ mang du bzla/ bla ma/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa yis| |dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams/ /bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig |gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste/ /thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can/ /'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi/ /thog med nas bsags sgo gsum rnyog pa rnams| |sbyongs byed zla med nor bu chu ldang gi/ dri med bde chen rgya mtsho 'phyur gyur cig ces gsol/ sgo gsum gnyis su med gyur pas/ /'khor lo sdom pa lhan skyes yab yum du/ /shin tu gsal gyur sku yi dga' ba'o/ /shrī ni gnyis med ye shes te/ he ni rgyu sogs stong pa nyid/ /ru ni bkod dang bral ba ste/ /ka ni gang du'ang mi gnas pa'o/ /don dran yi ge bzhi po gsal bar ni/ /ngag tu bzlas pa ngag gi dga' ba'o/ /shrī he ru ko3 haṃ/ snying khar bde mchog dang po'i yi ge hūm̐/ /'od zer lnga ldan ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin/ /rab tu gzi 'bar thugs kyi dga' ba'o/ 'od 'phros lus kyi phyi nang kun gang bas/ /dri ma kun sbyang 'od zer phyir 'phros nas/ /'og min sogs nas legs par spyan drangs pa'i| |dge legs rtsa ba drin can bla ma dang/ /dngos grub kun stsol yi dam lha tshogs rnams/ /sprin phung lta bur nam mkha' gang bar gyur/ /na mo gu ru tsakra saṃ ba ra bhi ra yo gi ni bh+yaḥ gang gi drin gyi bde chen nyid/ /skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*/ /bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku/ /rdo rje can gyi zhabs la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ /slob dpon la ni bdag skyabs mchi/

/dang por me tog 'phog pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'dud/ /shrī he ru ka ār+ghaṃ/ pat+yaṃ| puṣ+pe/ dhu pe nas shap+ta'i āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra bi ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ de bzhin du waṃ she/ mṛ daṃ ge/ mu ra dzi/ hā s+ya/ lā s+ya/ gī d+ya/ nṛ t+ya/ puṣ+pe/ dhu pe/ dī pe/ gan+he/ ru pa badz+ri| ra sa badz+ri/ yar+shebadz+ri/ dharma dhā tu badz+ra hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi nas/ 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog

/yig brgya brjod/ tshogs zhing rang la thims pas byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi spyi mgrin snying khar he ru ka /dkar dmar sngo ba rgyu 'bras brjod dang bral/ /bzung 'dzin gyis stong sgo gsum 'bru gsum gyur/ /'od 'phros sa 'og sa steng sa lha rnams| |'khor lo gsum gyur 'bru gsum rnams la thims/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ rnams rim bzhin thim pa yi/ /hūm̐ yang je phra nā da phra mor gyur/ /chos kun bden dang snang ba'i mtshan ma gnyis/ /nyer zhi nā da tsam yang dmigs med gyur/ /oṃ shū n+ya ta dzñā na badz+ra swā bha wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ rnal 'byor zhes bya 'chi ba chos sku'o/ /'od gsal ngang las bar srid nā da'i gzugs/ /shin tu phra ba dkar dmar nam mkhar 'khod/ /ma bcos lhan skyes 'khrul ngor lus kyi cha/ /rkang pa gnyis dgrad gzhu yi dbyibs can dang*/ /gsum mdo gru gsum lto ba zlum po dang*// snying kha gru bzhi rlung me chu sar gyur/ /sgal tshigs ri rab spyi bo'i rtsa so gnyis// ri steng sna tshogs pad+mar gyur pa'i stengs| |a ā/ i ī/ u.ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥrnams g.yas g.yon du bskor ba gnyis dang*/ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzña nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha/ k+ṣaḥ/ ḍa ḍha da dha ya la rnams g.yas g.yon du bskor ba gnyis te/ mtshan dpe'i rang bzhin dbyangs gsal las byung ba'i/ /zla ba dkar dmar dbyangs gsal gyis mtshan pa'i/ /dbyangs dang dkar cha me long ye shes dang*| |gsal byed dmar cha mnyam nyid ye shes so/ /rang nyid bar do longs sku nā da yis/ /bde stong snying rje chen pos bsam bzhin du/ /zla bar zhugs las thig le zla tshes dang*/ /mgo lus zhabs kyu rim bzhin grub pa yi/ /hūṃ yig sngon po ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin/ /'od zer lnga pa sor rtogs ye shes te/ /ye shes de gsum rjes su rnal 'byor ro/ /de las dpa' bo dpa' mo dpag med 'phro|

|'gro kun 'khor lo sdom pa'i gnas la bkod/ /der 'dus bde chen bya grub ye shes so/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ sarba bī ra yo gi ni kā ya wāka rtsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ oṃ badz+ra shung+nghaḥ sarba dharmabadz+ra shung+ngho3 haṃ/ zla ba dbyangs gsal hūṃ bcas yongs gyur pas/ /dur khrod bsrungs 'khor nang du he ru ka /yongs su rdzogs pa'i sku'i cha shas kyang*/ /rten dang brten pa go char bcas pa rnams/ /cig car rdzogs pa chos dbyings ye shes so/ /de nyid rim gyis gsal 'debs byed pa ni| |gzhi'i lus dang de'i snying nang gi /dkar dmar rtsar bcas gtso bo yab yum ni/ /byams thugs chos nyid 'gyur med sku mdog nag /stong nyid 'gro kun zil non gzi 'od 'bar/ /yab yum 'khyud pa phan tshun thabs shes sbyor// zhal bzhi rnam thar sgo bzhi stong pa nyid/ /g.yon bskor sngo ljang dmar ser khro zhal lo/ /bcu gnyis phyag ni rten 'brel bcu gnyis 'gog/g.yas rkyang ro gdan rtag chad srid zhi gnon/ /g.yas pas dus mtshan dmar mo'i nu ma dang*// g.yon pas 'jigs byed nag po'i rna ba gnan/ /rim bzhin cang ti kha trāṃ gri gug dang*/ /thod pa 'dzin cing rus pas brgyan pa'o/ /dang po'i phyag gnyis rdor dril yum la 'khyud/ /de 'og glang lpags brgyangs nas sdig mdzub bgrengs// gsum pa gnyis kyi cang te kha trāṃ ga /bzhi gnyis rta thod lnga gnyis gri gug zhags| |drug pa gnyis kyi rtse gsum tshangs mgo'o/ /stag sham glang lpags bdud bcom gti mug dral/ /mgo phreng ā li kā li thabs shes sbyor/ /zla phyed thal bas byang sems lus kun khyab/ /de'i bde ba kha traṃ thod pas mtshan/ /rdor dril ye shes lnga dang sher phyin don/ /phyag mtshan lhag ma sangs rgyas thams cad skul| |sgo gsum skyon dang mthar 'dzin rnam rtaug gcod/ /nyon mongs 'bigs shing yang dag ye shes 'ching*/ /skyon zad spangs pa tshangs pa'i mgo bo ste/

/zhi mtha' spangs pa'i gzugs sku thod skaṃ yin/ /zhal 'gyur log lta kun las log pa ste/ /bdud bzhi 'joms pa'i mche ba brtsig pa'o/ /ral pa gyen rdzais yon tan gong du 'phel/ /de mthar ye shes lngar gnas rdo rje'i phreng*/ /sna tshogs rdo rje 'phrin las rnam bzhi rgyas/ /phyag rgya drug ldan phyin drug lam mthar phyin// gar dgu zhi lhag nyams kun rdzogs pa'o/ /phag mo dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ /gri thod 'dzin pas yab 'khyud gzi 'bar ma/ /gcer mo skra grol phyag rgya lngas brgyan zhing*/ /thod skaṃ lngas brgyan lnga bcu'i do shal 'chang*/ /gri gug gdug pa kun sdigs bdud bzhi'i khrag /skra grol chos kyi dbyings las ye shes bskyed/ /gcer mo sgrib bral dmar zhing gzi 'bar ba/ /'gro ba kun chags mnyam par rtogs pa'o/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gnas bzhi gsang gnas byin brlabs snyoms zhugs pas/ /dga' bzhi yongs rdzogs rten dang brten pa kun| |bde stong ye shes ngo bor gsal ba ni/ /rang gi spyi bor rkang mthil rtsibs logs dang*/ /lpags pa ba spu skra sen rnam shes tshogs/ /rim bzhin sna tshogs rdo rje rdo rje'i gzhi/ /ra gur bla re mda' yi dra ba dang*/ /me ri dur khrod chen po'i rnam pa'o/ /'dom gang gru bzhi yas man mnyam pa'i lus/ /gru bzhi zur bzhi rkang brgyad ka ba'i tshogs/ /mig dang rna ba sna so lce mchu rnams/ /rtsig pa rta babs pha gu dra phyed dang*/ /'dod snam sogs te snying kha'i rtsa bugs bzhi// sgo bzhi la sogs rags pa rten yin no/ /snying kha'i rtsa khams mchog gnyis yab yum ste/ /phyogs kyi nang bskor snying po'i rnal 'byor ma/ /rgyal ba rigs bzhi mdzes pa'i tshul 'dzin ma/ /mkha' 'gro la ma dum skyes gzugs can ma/ /nag ljang dmar ser zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ /gri gug thod khrag 'dzin cing g.yas rkyang bstabs/ /gcer mo skra grol bzhad cing mche ba rtsigs/ /phyag rgya lngas brgyan g.yas 'gyings kha trāṃ 'dzin/

/mtshams kyi mchod pa'i rtsa bzhi bdud rtsi lngas/ /gang ba thod pa bzhi ste bde chen no/ /gnas chen nyer bzhi lus la gnas pa ni/ pū/ dzā/ au/ a/ go/ rā/ de/ mā/ kā o/ tri/ ko ka la/ kā hī/ pre| gri/ sau/ su/ nā/ si/ ma/ ku nyer bzhi'i rang bzhin rtsibs kyi rnam pa'o// der gnas rtsa khams dpa' bo yab yum ni/ /skra mtshams spyi gtsug rna g.yas ltag pa rnams/ /pu l+ler ma la dza lan+dha ra dang*/ /o ṭi ya na urbu ta rnams gnas| |rim bzhin thod pa'i dum bu rab gtum ma/ /ma hā kam ka la dang gtum mig ma/ /keng rus 'od ldan mche gtsigs sna che ma'o/ /rna g.yon smin mtshamasamig gnyis phrag pa rnams/ /go da wa ri ra mi shwa ra dang*/ /de bi ko ṭi ma la ba rnams ni/ /nye ba'i gnas te su ra wi re dang*/ /dpa' blo 'od dpag med dang kharna re/ /rdo rje 'od dang laṃ ka'i dbang phyug dang*/ /rdo rje sku dang shing grib thugs 'khor lo/ mkha' la spyod tshul gyis bzhugs nag po'o/ /mchan khung nu ma ka ma rū pa dang*/ oṃ ḍir myu gu can dang sa bsrungs ma/ /rdo rje ral ldan 'jigs byed chen mo zhing*/ /lte ba sna rtse dri sha kun ne dang*/ /ko sa lar ni dpa' chen rlung shugs dang*/ /rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad chang 'thung nye ba'i zhing*/ kha dang mgrin pa ka ling ka dang ni/ /lam+pa kar ni rab bzang sngo sangs ma/ /rdor bzang shin tu bzang mo mtshan dho haṃ/ /snying dang 'bras bu kañtsi hi ma lar/ /'jigs byed chen po rta na mig mi bzang*/ /bya gdong ma de nye mtshan gsung 'khor ro/ /sa steng spyod pa'i tshul bzhugs dmar po'o/ /mtshan ma shang laṃ pre ta pu ri dang*/ /graṃ ha de har stobs chen 'khor lo'i shugs/ /rin chen rdo rje dum skyes 'du ba ste/ /brla dang byin pa sogs '+wu ra ṭa dang*/ /gser gling nye ba'i 'du bar rta mgrin dang*// chang 'tshong naṃ snying 'khor lo'i go cha'o/ /sor mo bcu drug na ga ra dang ni/ /bol gong sin dur he ru ka dpal dang*/

/shin tu dpa' mo pad+ma gar dbang dang*// stobs chen ma ste de rnams dur khrod do/ /mthe bong bzhi dang dpus mo ma ru dang*| |ku lu tar ni rnam snang 'khor bsgyur ma/ /rdo rje sems dpa' brtson 'grus chen mo ste/ /nye ba'i dur khrod de ltar sku 'khor ro/ sa 'og spyod pa'i tshul bzhugs dkar po'o/ /nyer bzhi'i dpa' bo dpa' mo thams cad kyang*/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis dpa' bo g.yas brkyang bstabs/ /dar stod phyag rgya drug ldan mgo rlon 'phyang*/ /rdor dril 'dzin pas gcer mo skra graul zhing*/ /phyag rgya lngas brgyan 'og dpag bsil sil 'khraul/ /gri thod 'dzin par rab 'khyud khro chags nyams/ /snying kha'i phyi rim phyogs mtshams rtsa brgyad ni/ /shar sogs g.yon bskor me sogs g.yas bskor du/ kha dang 'ug gdong khyi dang phag gdong ma| |nag ljang dmar ser gshin rje brtan ma dang*/ /pho nya mo dang mche ba 'joms ma rnams/ /mdzes pa'i phyed gzugs kun kyang ro gdan can/ /mgo rlon do shal khyad par lhag ma rnams/ /snying po'i rnal 'byor ma rnams ji bzhin te| |'khor gyi lha kun dpral bar rdo rje'i phreng*/ /snang stong bde chen 'ja' tshon lta bu'o/ /de ltar lha'i gzhin lag sogs rgyas par sgom mi nus pa dang*/ long med na gnas de rnams kyi rtsa khams rnams hūm̐ bāṃ māṃ lāṃ pāṃ tāṃ pu dza oṃ sogs dang hūm̐ brgyad du gsal bar bsgom/ de yang mi nus na rtsa khams nyid lha dang yi ge dbyer med du mos shing gsal bar bya'o/ /de ltar bde stong dbyer med dkyil 'khor kun/ /dran pa nyer bzhag la sogs byang chub phyogs/ /sum cu rtsa bdun nyid du gnas pa'o/ /yab kyi thugs dkar oṃ ha rdor sems dkar/ /mgo bor na ma hi'aṃ rnam snang ser/ /spyir gtsug swāhā hu dang gar dbang dmar/ /phrag par baṣauṭa dang he dang khrag thung nag /mig gnyis hūm̐ hūm̐ ho dang nyi ma ser/ /dpral bar phaṭa haṃ rta mchog ljang khu'o/

/yum gyi lte bar oṃ baṃ phag mo dmar/ /snying khar haṃ yaṃ gshin rje ma ni sngo/ /mgrin par hriṃ moṃ rmongs byed ma ni dkar/ /mgo bor hriṃ hriṃ skyong byed ma ni ser/ /spyi gtsug hūm̐ hūm̐ skrag byed ma ljang ste/ /dpral bar phaṭa phaṭa tsaṇ+ḍi dud kha'o/ /de dag kun kyang phan tshun thabs shes sbyor/ /phyi nang bdud bgegs mtshon cha bzlog par 'gyur/ /thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer lcags kyu yis/ /mtha' med zhing na gdod nas bzhugs pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo dpag med spyan drangs 'gyur/ pheṃ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī tsakra saṃ wa ra maṇ+ḍa la tsakra sarba bī ra yo gi ni ār+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta pra tī ts+tsha swā hā/ dzaḥhūm̐ bāṃ hoḥganyis su med par gyur/ /slar yang hūm̐ gis dbang lha bla ma'i dngos/ /dkyil 'khor spyan drangs dbang bskur legs par stsol/ /zhes gsol bgegs bskrad shis brjod glu dbyangs len// mchod cing buṃ chus rgya cher dbang bskur gyur/ /ji ltar bltams pa tsam nyid na| |de bzhin gshegs kun khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu yis dbang bskur ro| |de bzhin 'di la shis gyur cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī āḥhūm̐/ /dbang thob skyon sbyang bde chen mchog tu rgyas/ /spyi bor lud pa'i chu rnams yongs gyur nas/ /gtso bo thugs 'khor rnams la mi bskyod pa/ /phag mo sku 'khor pa la rnam snang mdzad/ /snying po rin 'byung gsung 'khor 'od dpag med| |dam tshig 'khor lo don grub rgyas btab gyur/ /bum dbang des thob gtso bo yab yum gnyis/ /snyoms zhugs byams sems myangs pas gsang dbang thob| |phag mo rnang la 'dus shes gsum ldan gyis/ /sbyar ba'i bde stong myong bas gsum pa thob/ /bla mas gzhi'i sku thugs skyon sbyangs pas/ /'ja' lus mtshan dpes gsal rdzogs kha sbyor sku/ /bde chen stong par rtag bzhugs thugs mchog gnyis/

/dbyer med zung 'jug mthar thug bzhi pa zhes/ / gsungs pa'i don rtogs bzhi pa thob par 'gyur/ /dbang lha kun kyang dzaḥhūm̐ bāṃ hos bstim/ /de nas mchod pa la/ thog mar sngags mchod kyi lha gsal btab pa ni/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ḍā ki nī dz+wa la saṃ wa raṃ swāhā/ oṃ hrīḥha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ sarba bung+ngha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ ḍā ki nī hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ de bzhin du thog mtha' sbyar la| la me/ khaṇ+ḍa ro he/ rū pi ni/ ka ra ka ra/ pra tsaṇ+ḍe/ ku ru ku ru/ tsaṇ+ḍi ak+ṣi/ ban+dha ban+dha/ pra bha wa ti/ trā sa ya trā sa ya/ ma hā na se/ k+ṣo bha ya k+ṣo bha ya/ wī ra ma ti/ hroṃ hroṃ/ kharba ṛ*/ hraḥhraḥ/ laṃ gī shā ri ye/ pheṃ pheṃ/ dru mats+tshe/ phaṭa phaṭa/ ai ra ba ti/ da ha da ha*/ mā hā bhai ra bi/ pa tsa pa tsa/ bā yu be ge bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa ba sa tu dhi ra an+t+ra ma la ba lam+bi ni/ su ra bha k+ṣi/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa sap+ta pa ta la ga taṃ bhu dzaṃ ga sarba pā| ta rdzaya tardza ya/ sh+yā ma de wi/ ā gang+ngh+ya ā gad+dh+ya/ subha tre/ hrīṃ hrīṃ/ ha ya kar+ṇe/ dzñauṃ dzñauṃ/ kha gā na ne/ k+ṣ+māṃ k+ṣ+māṃ/ tsakra be ge/ haṃ haṃ/ khaṇ+ḍa ro he/ hiṃ hiṃ/ shoṇ+ḍi ni/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ tsakra barmi ni/ ki li ki li/ su bī re/ si li si li/ ma hā ba le/ hi la hi li/ tsakra brti ni/ dhi li dhi li/ ma hā bā+et+ye/ ka kā s+ye/ ū mu kā s+ye/ shwā nā s+ye/ shū ka ra s+ye/ ya ma ḍā dhi/ ya ma dū ti/ ya ma daṃṣ+taṃ ṇi/ oṃ ya ma ma tha ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ phyi'i mchod pa ni/ ye shes pa spyan drangs pa la sbyar ba'i oṃ sarba sogs yo gi ni ar+gha=ཾ pā t+yaṃ= āñtsa mā ṇaṃ= puṣ+pe nas/ shap+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ tshogs zhing ltar rig ma bcu drug rnams snying kha nas sprul pa'i lha mos mchod par mos pas dbul/ nang mchod ni oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mchod do/

dus gsum rgyal ba'i legs tshogs kun bsdus pa/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang rje btsun rnal 'byor ma/ /rdo rje dril bu pa dang rus sbal zhabs/ /'bar ba 'dzin dang nag po spyod pa dang*// gu h+ya rnam rgyal te lo nā ro tā/ /phaṃ mthing mched dang klog skya mal lo tsā/ /sa chen rtse mo rje btsun chen po dang/ /chos rje chos rgyal zhang dang brag phug pa/ /bla ma dam pa lo chen sems dpa' che/ /byang rtse grags rgyal 'jigs med grags pa'i zhabs| |dril bu lus dkyil bla mar oṃ āḥhūm̐/ /bde mchog phag mo mkha' 'gro mdzes ma dang*/ /dum skyes gzugs can bde chen 'khor lo'i tshogs// thod dum rab gtum keng chen gtum mig ma/ /keng rus 'od ldan mche brtsigs sna chen ma/ /lha dgra dpa' blo dpag med mi'u thung*/ /rdor 'od laṃ dbang rdor sku shing 'grib ma/ /drag mo'i las mdzad mkha' spyod thugs kyi tshogs/ /myug ldan sa bsrungs ral ldan 'jigs byed che/ /dpa' chen rlung shugs hūm̐ mdzad chang 'thung ma/ /rab bzang ljang la rdor bzang shin tu bzang*/ /'jigs chen rta na spyan bzang bya gdong ma/ /dbang gi las mdzad sa spyod gsung gi tshogs/ / stobs chen 'khor shugs rin rdor dum skyes ma/ /rta mgrin chang 'tshong nam snying 'khor go cha/

khrag 'thung rab dpa' gar dbang stobs chen ma/ /rnam snang 'khor bsgyur rdor sems brtson 'grus che/ /zhi ba'i las mdzad 'og spyod sku yis tshogs/ kha dang 'ug gdong khyi dang phag gdong ma/ /brtan ma pho nya mche ba 'joms ma ste/ /phyogs bcu'i gsang rnams su dga' ba dang mchog dga' dang khyad par gyi dga' ba dang*/ lhan cig skyes dga'i ye shes skyes pa'i bde ba des stong pa nges pa'i bde stong gi ye shes dbang gsum pa'i ngo bo nyams su myong bar gyur/ rig ma de dgyes nas/ deng nas bzung nas bu khyod kyis/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /rmis lam bzhin du sems can gyi/ /don ni bdag nyid kun gyis byos/ /zhes gsungs par gyur/ de ltar na bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ yid kyi dri ma sbyangs/ nor bu 'gengs pa'i rim pa sogs pho nya'i lam bsgom pa la dbang*/ thugs rdo rje chos sku'i nus pa mngon du byas so/ /dbang bzhi pa la/ maṇ+ḍal 'phul/ bdag nyid che khyod bka' drin gyis/ /gtso bor dbang bskur rnam gsum thob/ /de ring rin chen bzhi pa yang*| |bdag la bka' drin skyabs tu gsol/ /lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab| slob dpon gyis/ 'di ni rang nyid mdzes ma ste/ /phyir rol yul ni spangs pa'o/ /rig 'di bor na de las ni/ /gzhan pa'i thabs kyis 'tshang mi rgya| |brtul zhugs rnams kyi bla ma'i bla/ /rigs ma'i brtul zhugs spyod cig bu/ /zhes spyir rigs ma dang*/ dgos phyi rol bem chos spangs pa'i rang sems mdzes ma stong gzugs phyag rgya chen mor shar ba la bde stong sbyar ba'i gzhi dus kyi bde mchog lam gyi je bzang du song ba'i mthar thug gi zung 'jug ni thob bya mthar thug don gyi dbang bzhi pa zhes sam/ jo bo chen pos lo hi pa'i 'grel par gsungs pa sgrub thabs su bris pa brjod nas ngo sprod/ de ltar don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa tshig dbang rin po che thob|

sgo gsum gyi dri ma'i bag chags sbyangs/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa bsgom pa la dbang*/ ngo bo nyi sku'am lhan cig skyes pa'i sku'i nus pa mngon bzhin du byas so| |de nas/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi/ /sogs slob mas khas blangs/ maṇ+ḍal lus longs spyod dang bcas pa dbul/ bla mas btang rag gi mchod pa dang*/ tshogs 'khor smon lam bkris bya| dpon slob thams cad go cha gsum gyis bsrung ngo*/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug dril bu zhabs kyi lugs/ /nyung 'dus gsal bar grub chen nyid bzhed ltar| |stag tshang lo ts+tsha pradzñā rat+nas bkod/ /dge bas 'gro kun bde ba'i mchog thob shog /ces pa don gnyer 'ga'i ngor lcags pho stag gi dbyug gu'i mar ngau'i rdzogs pa gsum pa la gdung brgyud rin po che'i pho brang*/ rtse gdong bla brang du grub pa'o/ /dge bshes slob bkras mnyes pa'i thugs daṃ mdzod/ /yi ge pa ni khra skyes dar gyis bris/ /'di bris rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par shog /bkra shis par gyur cig/ // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ stag tshang lo tswa ba shes rab rin chen gyi bka' 'bum/ bde mchog dril bu lugs kyi mngon rtogs/ -PAGE 278--PAGE 279--PAGE 260-
